sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:79

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:79:1
items.html:
And the worlds rose in this manner: ZA rises to the place that is now the place of AA, etc. For just as the ZA of Atzilut first came out only in the discernment of VAK [six ends], lacking GAR [first three], and this is regarded in him as permanence, while the GAR that he attained afterward are regarded in him as the discernment of additions that are not permanent in him, so, in the same manner, in the first discernment BYA were emanated in the discernment of the VAK in them: for Beria came out in the place of the ZA of Atzilut, which is the discernment of VAK, and likewise Yetzira came out in the place of the Nukva of ZA, who clothes from the Chazeh [chest] downward, when the Nukva has only the discernment of VAK and lacks GAR. And this is regarded as the discernment of the permanent state of BYA, were it not for the sin of Adam HaRishon, which brought them down below the Parsa.
And now, at the fifth hour of the eve of Shabbat, holiness was added to them, as above in the passage beginning “From the hour,” and BYA attained Mochin of the discernment of addition, that is, the GAR in them. For ZA rose to the place of AA, and the Nukva to the place of Aba, that is, the upper AVI, and there the Nukva begot the Mochin for the world of Beria. And since the Mochin of Beria were emanated from the upper AVI, for the Nukva had risen there, and everything emanated from the upper AVI is regarded as YESHSUT, the world of Beria therefore then became the degree of the YESHSUT of Atzilut and attained her GAR. And in the same manner Beria emanated Mochin to the world of Yetzira, through which Mochin Yetzira became the degree of the ZA of Atzilut, for everything that comes out and is emanated from the degree of YESHSUT is regarded as the degree of ZA; and then Yetzira, too, attained her Mochin of GAR. And in the same manner Yetzira emanated Mochin to the world of Assiya, and since Yetzira is now at the degree of ZA, the Mochin of Assiya became the degree of the Nukva of Atzilut, who clothes ZA from his Chazeh downward, back to back, for she is the second degree after ZA. It follows that Assiya is now in the state of the world of Yetzira in the first discernment, where the GAR of Assiya clothe the Nukva of Atzilut, and her six lower ones remained beneath the Parsa, clothing the first six of the present world of Beria. And this is because the Nukva of Atzilut herself, in the place of her ascent, is also found clothing ZA only from the Chazeh downward, for ZA rose to the place of AA, and the Nukva did not rise there with him, but remained in AVI and clothes ZA from the Chazeh downward, in the manner explained above in the first discernment, regarding the six lower ones of Yetzira; see there.
